question: Which offices of an organization may read an organizing campaign (target employer, workplace, strategy, employer vulnerabilities, organizing team, card and contact counts, election figures), may a member who is not on the organizing team or a steward read it, may a federation or a staff representative of another organization read it, and which fields of a campaign must stay restricted to the organizing team because disclosure to an employer exposes workers and organizers to retaliation?
decision: Organizing campaign details, worker identities, strategy, vulnerabilities, card counts and contact counts are accessible only to explicitly named campaign team members and separately mandated oversight officers on need-to-know; being a general officer/admin does not confer a global view. External federation assistance requires an expiring, per-campaign scoped grant, never inherited affiliation access. Aggregate publication only after organizer approval and reidentification review.
originalProposedDecision: Only members of the campaign's organizing team plus the org's officers and admins read a campaign. Employer vulnerabilities, strategy, team, card and contact counts are team-only. No federation or other-org access without an explicit per-campaign grant. Add a team-membership table and enforce it.
